set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- trim((attributes.uriParams.'orderId' default payload.orderId) as String replace '*' with '')]
set-variable.doc:name: Set orderId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java fun clean(val) = if (val != null) trim(val as String replace '*' with '') else null --- [{ External_Order_Id__c: vars.orderId, Customer_Id__c: clean(vars.upsertPayload.customer.customerId), Customer_Name__c: clean(vars.upsertPayload.customer.name), Customer_Email__c: clean(vars.upsertPayload.customer.email), Total__c: vars.upsertPayload.total as Number, Currency_Code__c: clean(vars.upsertPayload.currency) default "MXN", Status__c: "SYNCED" }]

when.expression: #[(vars.headerUpsertResult.successful default false) == false or (vars.headerUpsertResult.items[0].successful default false) == false]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise SALESFORCE_REJECTED (502)
raise-error.description: #['Salesforce rechazo la cabecera de la orden ' ++ (vars.orderId default '') ++ ': ' ++ (vars.headerUpsertResult.items[0].message default (vars.headerUpsertResult.items[0].payload.errors[0].message default 'Error desconocido'))]

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query Header SF ID by External ID
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id FROM Retail_Order__c WHERE External_Order_Id__c = ':extId' LIMIT 1

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.upsertPayload.items map (item) -> { External_Line_Id__c: vars.orderId ++ "-" ++ item.sku, Order__c: vars.salesforceOrderId, SKU__c: item.sku, Quantity__c: item.quantity as Number, Unit_Price__c: item.unitPrice as Number, Subtotal__c: item.subtotal as Number }

when.expression: #[(vars.itemsUpsertResult.successful default false) == false or sizeOf((vars.itemsUpsertResult.items default []) filter ($.successful == false)) > 0]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var failed = (vars.itemsUpsertResult.items default []) filter ($.successful == false) --- (failed map ((f, idx) -> "Linea " ++ (idx + 1) ++ ": " ++ ((f.errors..message joinBy '; ') default 'Fallo')) joinBy " | ") default "Error parcial en lineas"

raise-error.doc:name: Raise SALESFORCE_REJECTED (502)
raise-error.description: #['Salesforce rechazo una o mas lineas de la orden: ' ++ (vars.failedLinesMsg default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var lineCount = sizeOf(vars.itemsUpsertResult.items default []) --- { orderId: vars.orderId, salesforceId: vars.salesforceOrderId default "", syncStatus: "SYNCED", syncedItems: lineCount, message: "Cabecera y " ++ lineCount ++ " lineas sincronizadas por External ID." }

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query Header from Salesforce
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, External_Order_Id__c, Customer_Id__c, Customer_Name__c, Customer_Email__c, Total__c, Currency_Code__c, Status__c FROM Retail_Order__c WHERE External_Order_Id__c = ':extId' LIMIT 1

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query Items from Salesforce
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT External_Line_Id__c, SKU__c, Quantity__c, Unit_Price__c, Subtotal__c FROM Retail_Order_Item__c WHERE Order__c = ':sfOrderId'

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var h = vars.sfHeaderResult[0] --- { orderId: h.External_Order_Id__c, salesforceId: h.Id, customer: { customerId: h.Customer_Id__c default "", name: h.Customer_Name__c default "", email: h.Customer_Email__c default "" }, items: (vars.sfItemsResult default []) map (i) -> { sku: i.SKU__c default "", quantity: (i.Quantity__c default 0) as Number, unitPrice: (i.Unit_Price__c default 0) as Number, subtotal: (i.Subtotal__c default 0) as Number }, total: (h.Total__c default 0) as Number, currency: h.Currency_Code__c default "MXN" }

raise-error.doc:name: Raise ORDER_NOT_FOUND_SF (404)
raise-error.description: #['La orden ' ++ (vars.orderId default '') ++ ' no fue encontrada en Salesforce CRM.']
